# Who Is the Boss of the Government?

<!-- STEP id="term-over" -->
## Five Years Are Up

A government's term has ended and an election is over. Soon a new team will sit in the same offices. What gives the new team the right to govern?

<!-- STEP id="name-the-boss" -->
## Try Naming the Boss

The outgoing Prime Minister, the police and the judges all look like good answers. Tap each one to see why it fails.

**So who is the boss?**
